implementationNotes: The stock quest script initializes six handlers concurrently. The source header documents their intended order, but the handlers do not all enforce a strict prior-flag dependency; treat each flag as that node's success state, and confirm physical access requirements separately.

nodes.title: Teleport the Gersh Device
nodes.instruction: Throw a Gersh Device at the sparking transformer near the base entrance. Follow it to the lander in the Storage area.
nodes.completionCue: The transformer reaches the Storage area and the quest advances.

nodes.title: Activate the Casimir terminal
nodes.instruction: Turn on the power, then use the terminal in the Storage area.
nodes.completionCue: The terminal changes to the Casimir symbol and the quest advances.

nodes.title: Activate the monkey-round switches
nodes.instruction: During a Space Monkey round, press the reward switches beside the perk machines.
nodes.completionCue: The switches activate and the quest advances.

variantNotes.any_player_ee: The installed v2.3.1 source changes the required count using any_player_ee_cosmodrome_buttons; its default fallback uses current player count.
variantNotes.any_player_ee_sr: The documented SR settings configure four buttons and add 100000 ms; confirm active configuration before applying.
variantNotes.unknown: Do not infer a button count or timeout from the interaction signal.

nodes.title: Hold the pressure plate
nodes.instruction: Have every player stay inside the pressure area by the rocket pad for two minutes. Leaving the area resets the timer.
nodes.completionCue: The timer finishes and the quest advances.

nodes.title: Spell LUNA with the landers
nodes.instruction: Call the lander to collect L, U, N, and A in order: Spawn to Stamin-Up, Stamin-Up to Spawn, Spawn to Speed Cola, then Speed Cola to Stamin-Up. A missed letter resets the sequence.

variantNotes.any_player_ee: The installed v2.3.1 source enables solo letter pickup under its configured player threshold; co-op gating is otherwise unchanged.
variantNotes.unknown: Do not infer a solo pickup rule unless the variant/config is confirmed.

nodes.title: Complete the weapon combination
nodes.instruction: Throw a Gersh Device at the marked point. While the portal is open, hit it with the Pack-a-Punched Ray Gun and Thundergun, then use Matryoshka Dolls if needed.
nodes.completionCue: The portal releases Gersh and the reward sequence begins.

variantNotes.any_player_ee: Installed v2.3.1 source initializes the Doll check as satisfied for the configured solo threshold; weapon damage and success flag remain map-script logic.
variantNotes.unknown: Do not assume the Doll requirement is waived without confirmed variant/config evidence.

nodes.title: Power the ship
nodes.instruction: Reach the ship's upper control room and activate the power switch.

nodes.title: Contact the trapped crew
nodes.instruction: Knife the sealed Ultimis door below the PhD room to start the crew dialogue.

nodes.title: Install the door fuse
nodes.instruction: Find the fuse in one of the nearby PhD-room locations, install it in the fusebox beside the door, then knife the door again.

nodes.title: Destroy the four generators
nodes.instruction: Destroy all four red security generators with explosives, then knife the door when prompted.
nodes.completionCue: All four generators are dark and the door stage advances.

nodes.title: Ensemble Cast — catch Nikolai's vodka
nodes.instruction: One player knocks the frozen bottle from a railing while another catches it before it breaks; deliver it to the tube beside the door.

nodes.title: Ensemble Cast — complete Art Critic
nodes.instruction: Four portraits show four places. Have one player stand on each matching pressure plate; the lighthouse signal advances when all required positions are occupied.
nodes.completionCue: Art Critic stage completes and the lighthouse signal sequence begins.

nodes.title: Bring up the submarine
nodes.instruction: Read the lighthouse Morse signal, set the ship wheel and telegraph operator as shown, then listen for the horn and submarine response.
nodes.completionCue: The submarine surfaces and answers with its horn.

nodes.title: Ensemble Cast — complete Musical Chairs
nodes.instruction: Use the lighthouse Morse signal to set the ship controls. After the submarine surfaces, use its horn pattern to activate the matching lighthouse sound beacons.

nodes.title: Solve Pure Harmony
nodes.instruction: Use the Vril map clues to set the lighthouse dials to 2-7-4-6: yellow, orange, blue, and purple from top to bottom.

nodes.title: Raise and recover the Golden Rod
nodes.instruction: Shoot a zombie with the V-R11 at the lighthouse base so it rises in the green beam. Damage the human until it drops limp before reaching the top; collect the Golden Rod.
nodes.completionCue: Golden Rod appears at lighthouse base

nodes.title: Free the crew
nodes.instruction: Insert the Golden Rod into the transfer tube beside the door, wait for the full dialogue, then knife the sparking fusebox when prompted.
nodes.completionCue: Crew leaves; Wunderwaffe DG-2 reward appears

nodes.title: Enter the Eclipse
nodes.instruction: After turning on the power, press the buttons around Quick Revive together.

nodes.title: Speak to Brock and Gary
nodes.instruction: In the past, interact with the explorers behind the wall near the MPL.

nodes.title: Match the temple tiles
nodes.instruction: Press the button beside the mine cart to raise the tiles. Match all 12 pairs between the mine-cart side and rope-bridge side.
nodes.completionCue: The Eclipse ends and the first crystal appears.

nodes.title: Clear the waterslide plate
nodes.instruction: During the Eclipse, hold the grate while a player rides down the waterslide and activates the lever.
nodes.completionCue: The Eclipse ends and the second crystal appears.

nodes.title: Shrink and launch the crystal
nodes.instruction: Get the 31-79 JGb215 (Baby Gun). Knock the ball down with an explosive, shrink it, knife it down the slide, then launch it with the geyser.
nodes.completionCue: The Eclipse ends and the third crystal appears.

nodes.title: Ignite the gas leaks
nodes.instruction: Open the tunnel valve four times. Lure a Napalm Zombie through the three leaking pipes, then pull the nearby lever.

nodes.title: Plug the waterfall tunnel
nodes.instruction: Use one Spikemore at each of the four wall holes on the waterfall tunnel, then press the brick at the pool bottom.

nodes.title: Set the mud-room dials
nodes.instruction: Melee the 12 symbol tiles around the map, destroy the outside teepee with an explosive, then set the four mud-room dials to 4, 3, 16, 1.

nodes.title: Find the four correct gongs
nodes.instruction: Upgrade the Baby Gun to the Fractalizer. Test the eight gongs and keep the four that ring with the right tone. The correct gongs change each match.
nodes.completionCue: All four correct gongs ring and the crystals glow.

nodes.title: Catch Brock's dynamite
nodes.instruction: While the crystals glow, shoot the crystal above the mine-cart geyser with the Fractalizer and stand beneath the falling dynamite to catch it.

nodes.title: Shrink the meteor
nodes.instruction: Shoot the mud-room crystal with the Fractalizer so the beam chain reaches and shrinks the meteor above Pack-a-Punch.

nodes.title: Give Brock the dynamite
nodes.instruction: Reach the Pack-a-Punch wall, wait for Brock's dialogue, hand over the dynamite, then have all players leave the stairs to end the Eclipse.

nodes.title: Collect the Focusing Stone
nodes.instruction: Outside the Eclipse, return to the Pack-a-Punch altar and pick up the Focusing Stone.

nodes.title: Prepare Moon
nodes.instruction: Turn on the power. Collect a P.E.S. and Hacker from the laboratories, and make sure Richtofen and the quest equipment are available.
nodes.completionCue: Power is on and the required equipment is ready.

nodes.title: Complete the first Samantha Says sequence
nodes.instruction: At the four Area 51/Receiving Bay computers, repeat each displayed colour sequence. Later rounds increase the sequence length; a failure restarts the sequence.

nodes.title: Hack the laboratory panels
nodes.instruction: Start the panel challenge with the Hacker, find and hack four of the eight lit panels before the timer ends, then press the four wall buttons in quick succession.

nodes.title: Recover and guide the Vril Sphere
nodes.instruction: Wait for Excavator Pi to breach Tunnel 6, hack it away, then move the sphere from the tunnel through the route to the MPD interface. Use the required weapons at the satellite dish and Stamin-Up ceiling stops.
nodes.completionCue: Sphere seats in the MPD interface

nodes.title: Open the MPD
nodes.instruction: Fill the first soul tube with nearby zombie kills, then pull the lever when it fills.

nodes.title: Retrieve the hexagonal plates
nodes.instruction: At Area 51, knock the plates from the shelf with an explosive, then throw a Gersh Device to send them to the teleporter. Bring them back to the Moon spawn area.
nodes.completionCue: The plates arrive beside the spawn computer.

nodes.title: Find and connect the S-shaped cable
nodes.instruction: Search the laboratory floors and nearby exterior for the S cable; install it between the spawn computer and plate assembly.
nodes.completionCue: Cable connects computer and plate assembly

nodes.title: Charge the Vril Device
nodes.instruction: Richtofen places the Golden Rod between the connected plates. Use the computer until the device is charged.
nodes.completionCue: The Vril Device glows and can be picked up.

nodes.title: Fill the four MPD soul tubes
nodes.instruction: Feed each of the four corner tubes with nearby zombie kills.

nodes.title: Swap Richtofen and Samantha
nodes.instruction: Place the charged Vril Device in the MPD to switch their souls.

nodes.title: Complete the computer sequence
nodes.instruction: Throw a Q.E.D. at the Black Egg to move it beside the computers, then repeat the longer colour sequence.

nodes.title: Launch the rockets
nodes.instruction: When prompted, throw a Gersh Device beside the Vril Sphere and computers. Let the countdown and finale play.
nodes.completionCue: The rockets launch and the quest finale begins.

variantRules.any_player_ee: Use the Any Player EE path only when the mod variant is positively identified. Confirm Richtofen has the mod-provided Vril Generator; the flow then bypasses the vanilla plate/cable acquisition and charging nodes. Do not mark skipped vanilla nodes as completed.
variantRules.any_player_ee_sr: Unsupported by the supplied SR release description; remain Unknown/unsupported rather than inheriting Ascension/Shangri-La rules.
